title: Orchard and Clock
author: Dominic Lockridge
blurb: Emrys Vane, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
